title: curation/detail-source-authority.json

data_class.description: The data class this record governs, matching pipeline/acquire/detail_source.py's own class-to-table mapping. Only a class this feature has actually measured against FR-009's criteria may be declared -- a class not listed here stays on the build's default arm (WGC_DETAIL_ACQUISITION_MODE).

arm.description: Which acquisition arm is authoritative for this class.

reason.description: Which FR-009 criterion failed, and the measurement that failed it (e.g. 'criterion 1, loadout.options_resolved 79%/94.3%, below the 96 floor'). Never about what either source's cards say.

declared_at.description: The date this record was authored.
